messages:
Kate (release): Heads-up: planning to shift canary slice 3 -> 5 tonight 02:00 UTC. This includes kernel v2.3.1 + quant-profile q1.06. Need owners for smoke + rollback readiness.
Sam (runtime): I can own smoke from 01:45-03:00 UTC. Will run perf baselines and smoke suite.
Jamal (infra): I will handle infra validation and slot claim. Prefer 5% traffic but fine with 10% if needed.
Priya (sre): I'll stand up temporary dashboards and adjust alert thresholds for the window.
Li (engine): Quick note: kernel v2.3.1 introduces new fused-attn kernel. We should set KERNEL_FLAGS=fast_attn. Also quant q1.06 changes kv cache layout; smoke needs kv-hit checks.
Li (engine): config snippet:
```bash
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/engine KERNEL_PROFILE=v2.3.1 QUANT_PROFILE=q1.06 KERNEL_FLAGS=fast_attn
```
Sam (runtime): Can we lock the canary to a single model family (t-1 variants) to reduce surface area?
Kate (release): Yes — limit to model-family=redwood-tiny,t-small for the canary. Canary window 02:00-03:00 UTC, target traffic 10% (Jamal you said pref 5% — final set to 10% for faster signal).
Kate (release): Rollback plan: revert env vars to KERNEL_PROFILE=v2.2.9 QUANT_PROFILE=q1.05, wait 10m for rollout. If latency > baseline or errors spike, rollback immediately.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary slice update at 1970012345. Command: `/deploy runtime --slice=5 --canary --profile=q1.06 --traffic=10%`
Priya (sre): I'll create a short-lived alert: token_latency_p99 > baseline*1.3 for 5m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 2m. Dashboard link will be posted here when ready.
Sam (runtime): pinging @Oncall-Ash for the 02:00 slot — can you be available?
Oncall-Ash: I'm oncall and available 01:50-03:30 UTC. Happy to assist with rollbacks.
Kate (release): Quick preflight checklist (copy-paste):
- Owner claimed (smoke): Sam
- Infra slot claimed: Jamal
- Monitoring + alerts: Priya
- Rollback cmd known and tested locally
- Canary model-family locked
- Smoke runbook updated in /docs/deploys/runtime-canary.md
Sam (runtime): Confirmed. I'll run preflight at 01:30 UTC (health checks, perf baseline, kv hit sanity).
Jamal (infra): I'll run infra preflight at 01:35 UTC (slot capacity, CIDR rules, node readiness).
Priya (sre): Monitoring created. Short dashboard posted: https://dashboards.internal/runtime/canary/1970012345
Li (engine): Minor runtime note: bump max_seq_len=2048 for the canary if you anticipate chat sessions; otherwise long requests may trigger tokenization regression.
Sam (runtime): Added max_seq_len=2048 to smoke cases.
Kate (release): After canary: if metrics stable for 30m we promote slice -> full rollout with staged ramp. If not stable, rollback and open follow-up thread.
Sam (runtime): Will post smoke pass/fail and key numbers (p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, kv hit) here within 10m of canary start.
Kate (release): Thanks everyone. Final trigger scheduled for 01:55 UTC. Please ack here when you see the deploy start. :thumbsup:
Sam (runtime): ack :thumbsup:
Jamal (infra): ack
Priya (sre): ack
Oncall-Ash: ack
Kate (release): If anything unexpected, tag me and oncall. Otherwise I'll post promotion decision after the 30m stability window.
